title: One rescaled ball: the measure class of the rescalings of T and of all minimizing cycles of ℝ^P, with properties (M1)–(M9) (parent steps 1–2; tangent cones from density_and_tangent_cones)
statement: Assume (DEM), (MON), (DTC) and (PS). Here (DEM) is the frozen statement of Submission.idtp_imrep_measure_density_ae (the registered dependency density_eq_multiplicity_ae of the selected node); (MON) is the frozen type of the sibling child monotonicity (Submission.idtp_fons_minimizing_monotonicity); (DTC) is the contract proposition DensityAndTangentCones (the frozen type of the sibling child tangent_cones, Submission.idtp_fons_density_tangent_cones); (PS) is the conclusion of the sibling child planar_support (Submission.idtp_fons_invariant_planar_support). (DEM): For all P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, every set U ⊆ ℝ^P and every integer multiplicity triple R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep U n (carrier M, multiplicity θ : ℝ^P → ℕ, orientation ξ), if the measure μ_R := R.measure = θ·μHE[n]⌞M satisfies μ_R(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, then for μHE[n]-almost every x ∈ ℝ^P the ratio μ_R(B_ρ(x))/(ω_nρ^n) (open balls, ω_n = unitBallVolume n, computed in [0, ∞]) tends to 1_M(x)·θ(x) as ρ ↓ 0. (MON): Let P, n, d ∈ ℕ with 1 ≤ n ≤ d ≤ P, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let N ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C² d-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N) with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and let T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be minimizing in U ∩ N (IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N)) with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T). Then: (i) for every compact K ⊆ U there is Λ ≥ 0 such that for every y ∈ ℝ^P and R > 0 with closedBall y R ⊆ K the function ρ ↦ e^{Λρ}ρ^{−n}·M_{B_ρ(y)}(T) (in [0, ∞], written ofReal(e^{Λρ}/ρ^n)·T.massOn (ball y ρ)) is nondecreasing on (0, R); (ii) if N = ℝ^P, then for every y and R with B_R(y) ⊆ U the function ρ ↦ ρ^{−n}·M_{B_ρ(y)}(T) is nondecreasing on (0, R); (iii) there is Θ : ℝ^P → ℝ with HasMassDensity T y (Θ(y)) (Θ^n(μ_T, y) = Θ(y)) for every y ∈ U and Θ upper semicontinuous on U; (iv) if y ∈ spt T and HasMassDensity T y θ, then θ ≥ 1. (DTC): Let ℓ ≤ k, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-submanifold with (N̄∖N) ∩ U = ∅, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N. Then (1) there is Θ: ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ such that Θ^n(μ_T, x) = Θ(x) (limit of M_{B_ρ(x)}(T)/(ω_nρ^n) as ρ ↓ 0, with Θ(x) ≥ 0) for every x ∈ U ∖ spt ∂T, and Θ is upper semicontinuous on U ∖ spt ∂T; (2) for every x ∈ spt T ∖ spt ∂T and every sequence λ_j > 0, λ_j → 0, there are a subsequence λ_{j'} and an integer multiplicity C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^{n+k}), minimizing in ℝ^{n+k}, with η_{x,λ_{j'}#}T ⇀ C in ℝ^{n+k}, μ_{η_{x,λ_{j'}#}T} → μ_C (for all representations), η_{0,λ#}C = C for all λ > 0, and Θ^n(μ_C, 0) = Θ^n(μ_T, x). (PS): For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) and every linear subspace L ⊆ ℝ^P with n ≤ P and dim L + 1 = n: if S is minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn S univ), ∂S = 0 (BoundaryVanishes S), and HasMassDensity S w θ implies HasMassDensity S (y + λw) θ for all y ∈ L, λ > 0, w ∈ ℝ^P and θ ∈ ℝ, then there is an n-dimensional linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P with spt S ⊆ Q. Under these hypotheses: let n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and n ≥ 1, P := n + k, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, N an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N) with (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) minimizing in U ∩ N with spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T). Let z ∈ ℝ^P and r > 0 with closedBall z (2r) ⊆ U and spt T ∩ B_{2r}(z) ≠ ∅. For a measure μ on ℝ^P and x ∈ ℝ^P let dens μ x := (limsup_{ρ↓0} μ(B_ρ(x))/(ω_nρ^n)).toReal (limsup in [0, ∞] along ρ → 0⁺, ω_n = unitBallVolume n; in the Lean statement dens is a universally quantified function fixed by this defining equation); for y ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0, μ^{y,λ} := ofReal(λ^{−n})•μ.map(η_{y,λ}) (= λ^{−n}(η_{y,λ})_#μ, η_{y,λ} = dilation y λ); spt μ := {w : μ(B_ε(w)) ≠ 0 for every ε > 0}; μ_j → μ vaguely means ∫ f dμ_j → ∫ f dμ for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ. Then there are a set 𝓜 of measures on ℝ^P, a map D from measures on ℝ^P to subsets of ℝ^P, a measure μ₀ and Λ ∈ ℝ such that μ₀ ∈ 𝓜, D(μ₀) = B_2(0), for every w ∈ B_2(0): w ∈ spt μ₀ ⟺ z + rw ∈ spt T, and (M1) every μ ∈ 𝓜 is finite on compact sets; (M2) every μ ∈ 𝓜 equals Hⁿ.withDensity(ofReal ∘ dens μ) (Hⁿ = μHE[n]); (M3) for μ ∈ 𝓜, 0 < λ < 1 and |y| ≤ 1 − λ: μ^{y,λ} ∈ 𝓜 and D(μ^{y,λ}) = η_{y,λ}(D μ); (M4) for μ ∈ 𝓜, |y| < 1 and every strictly decreasing sequence λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0 there are a strictly increasing sub : ℕ → ℕ and ν ∈ 𝓜 with dens ν(tw) = dens ν(w) for all t > 0 and w, and μ^{y,λ_{sub(j)}} → ν vaguely; (M5) for μ ∈ 𝓜, D μ is open and contains B_2(0); (M6) if μ ∈ 𝓜, μ_j ∈ 𝓜 (j ∈ ℕ) and μ_j → μ vaguely, then every compact K ⊆ D μ satisfies K ⊆ D(μ_j) for all large j; (M7) for μ ∈ 𝓜, y ∈ spt μ and ρ > 0 with closedBall y ρ ⊆ D μ: e^{−Λρ}·ω_nρ^n ≤ μ(B_ρ(y)); (M8) if ν ∈ 𝓜 and L is a linear subspace with dim L + 1 = n and dens ν(y + tw) = dens ν(w) for all y ∈ L, t > 0 and w, then spt ν ⊆ Q for some n-dimensional linear subspace Q; (M9) if ν ∈ 𝓜 and dens ν(tw) = dens ν(w) for all t > 0 and w, then D ν = ℝ^P.
